ambrose-widows: Ambrose of Milan, On Widows (De viduis), AD 377
jerome-letter-54: Jerome, Letter 54, to Furia, on remaining a widow (AD 394)
diodorus-persian: Diodorus of Sicily, Library of History (first century BC), book 16.47–50 (Bagoas) and the fragments of book 31.19 (Holophernes of Cappadocia)
second-helvetic: The Second Helvetic Confession (Heinrich Bullinger, 1566), chapter 29, "Of Celibacy, Marriage and the Management of Domestic Affairs"
apostolic-canons: The Apostolic Canons (Syria, late 300s AD), canons 64 and 69, in the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, series 2, vol. 14, and the Orthodox Rudder (Pedalion)
paenitemini: Paul VI, apostolic constitution Paenitemini, on fast and abstinence (17 February 1966)
tosafot-megillah: Tosafot on the Babylonian Talmud, Megillah 4a, s.v. she-af hen hayu be-oto ha-nes (France and Germany, 1100s–1200s), citing Rashbam on Judith
